en.title: Kentucky Launches Accessible Housing Tool Amid Nationwide Disability Access Push
en.summary: Kentucky has launched a new online tool enabling people with disabilities to locate accessible housing and public places, boosting independence and community inclusion. Meanwhile, Toyota is deploying mobile barrier‑free toilets for the Asian Games, and advocates warn that recent wildfires exposed critical gaps in disaster‑response accessibility for disabled individuals. A Chennai transit survey revealed persistent accessibility gaps, while a mother reported that accessible Noah Kahan tickets failed to accommodate her daughter's wheelchair, and an ASL practice video with descriptions highlights ongoing efforts to improve digital accessibility.

highlights.title: New tool helps Kentuckians find accessible places and housing
Toyota Provides Mobile Barrier-Free Toilets for Asian Games
Survey shows accessibility gaps in public transportation across Chennai
Mother says accessible Noah Kahan tickets for Coors Field didn't accommodate daughter's wheelchair

zh-TW.title: 肯塔基州推出無障礙住房搜尋工具，殘障權益獲關注
zh-TW.summary: 肯塔基州推出一款線上工具，讓殘障人士能夠搜尋無障礙住房與公共場所，提升自主生活與社區參與。同時，豐田為亞洲運動會部署可移動無障礙廁所，而近期野火凸顯災害應變中對殘障人士的無障礙缺口。金奈公共交通調查顯示無障礙差距持續存在，一位母親指出可供輪椅使用的諾亞·卡漢門票未能滿足女兒需求，且美國手語練習影片附描述強調數位無障礙的改進。

highlights.title: 新工具助肯塔基州民眾尋找無障礙場所與住房
豐田為亞洲運動會提供可移動無障礙廁所
野火揭露無障礙失誤：倡議者
